name: Falsification Sampler
description: Selects experimental conditions that are most likely to falsify the current model by maximizing predicted model error.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of samples to select that may falsify the model.

parameters.name: training_epochs
parameters.description: Number of epochs to train the Popper network for error approximation.

parameters.name: training_lr
parameters.description: Learning rate for training the Popper network.

parameters.name: plot
parameters.description: Whether to display Popper network predictions and training loss.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate.

inputDataType.name: model
inputDataType.description: Trained sklearn model to attempt to falsify.

inputDataType.name: reference_conditions
inputDataType.description: Experimental conditions the model was trained on.

inputDataType.name: reference_observations
inputDataType.description: Observations the model was trained to predict.

inputDataType.name: metadata
inputDataType.description: Variable collection with dependent and independent variable metadata.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Selected conditions with highest predicted model error.
